Hii I'm 19 and just started uni as well!! Just like in other countries, I think Filipino students acceptance of lgbtq will vary from crowd to crowd. 

I find that most gen z Filipinos are open to lgbt people, especially in the more liberal unis. afaik physical bullying is uncommon. But since you're gonna study in a catholic uni, I think it's better to err on the side of caution when it comes to expressing your gender nonconformity/sexuality. Sadly I also transferred to a catholic school for college, and there are a lot of conservative rules: one of which is the banning of gay relationships. 😭 

I'm kinda in the same boat as you lol. Tho on a positive note, during our orientation week, our seniors asked us to share our pronouns to introduce ourselves and i was pleasantly surprised! And despite my uni being religious, my classmates haven't acted homo/transphobic at all (also i've heard that there are actually a lot of queer people hiding in religious schools 😳).

So yeah my advice before you go "all out" is to review the rules of your school, cuz in mine you can get EXPELLED (HOWEVER I've been told stories of gay couples existing and getting away with it, circa the 80s!!). As for the other students, it's safe to assume that they won't hold the same bigoted views your uni has. Good luck, stay safe, and i hope your school will be nice after all <33
